name: branding-blue-orange-yellow-brand-kit-tiles-with-atom-heart-mark
title: Blue, Orange and Yellow Brand Kit Tiles
whatItIs: A bento board of tiles: blue stripe ramp, warm gradient, a button, a typeface card 'Roobert', a navy tile with big AaBbCc glyphs, a warm-gradient tile with a white orbit-heart symbol and six vertical swatches with rotated hex codes.
whatItMeans: Blue against orange and yellow feels human and optimistic, and the bento shows the whole system at a glance.
techniques: Vertical swatch strip with rotated hex labels
Blue stripe ramp as a tonal scale
Warm mesh gradient behind the mark
One large glyph tile to show the type
bestFor: Colour, type and logo in one board

vocabulary.definition: Stripes of one hue from dark to light.
A tile showing letters, numerals and symbols.
Text set vertically along a swatch.
